calls.title: Ryan/Ashley - Brainstorm - adding "Latest News from GrowthBook" section to Open Source edition
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to boost user engagement and monetization within the open-source community by proposing an in-app messaging area to broadcast updates, such as webinars, and provide direct contact links to team members. They reviewed existing community sections and FAQ pages, recognizing that these areas do not effectively serve as landing pages for most users. A proposal for automated content integration via blog APIs was also considered to keep content fresh with minimal engineering effort required. Next steps included developing a prototype to visualize the in-app messaging feature and gain stakeholder buy-in, while further discussions focused on customer interactions for support and upselling opportunities, as well as challenges in customer data integration and content management.
calls.keywords: Open Source, Monetization, In-App Notifications, Ghost CMS, GrowthBook Blog, User Engagement

calls.title: Ryan & Ashley - Making AI Smarter
calls.summary: The meeting focused on key changes in webinar staffing, with Bryce replaced by Adriel, ensuring continuity in the upcoming event through a coordination meeting involving Luke and Bryce. Ryan and Ashley emphasized developing short-form videos targeting key product features to boost engagement on social media, aiming for effective storytelling. Additionally, Ryan is finalizing a comprehensive article on feature flags, seeking feedback to enhance clarity and depth for educational purposes. The team identified significant API and feature gaps in the MCP server to improve usability, while also analyzing competitive positioning to leverage GrowthBook's strengths in the market. Insights on open source user engagement were discussed, along with the introduction of new product analytics features aimed at enhancing user experience and driving revenue opportunities.
calls.keywords: MCP server, feature flag, AB testing, AI evals, product analytics, open source users
